APPROVE
The refactor keeps the original logic, short-circuit order and evaluation order, so behaviour is unchanged; `Replaced` drops to about 4 (`foreach`, nested `if`, `&&`) and each extracted helper stays well under 15; and every signature reuses the `SelectorFacts`/`Rule`/`Decl` types already used by `Outranks`, with `System.Linq` already in use, so it should build cleanly.
